item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Arabic Sociolinguistics (Jrnl)
item.description: The Journal of Arabic Sociolinguistics welcomes research which applies new theories and methodologies to Arabic data. We are particularly interested in articles that address the relation between linguistic variation and identity, variation and sociolinguistic variables (including but not limited to location, social class, education, age, gender, and urbanization), and variation and political contexts . item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Caucasus Survey - "Special Issue: Changing Linguistic Ecologies in the Caucasus" (Jrnl)
item.description: The Caucasus is characterized by extraordinary linguistic diversity and a long history of multilingualism, language contact, and cultural interaction. Across the region, however, linguistic ecologies are undergoing significant transformations in response to changing demographic patterns, migration, urbanization, educational policies, political developments, conflict, and globalization. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! A new community owned, Diamond Open Access journal dedicated to research on meaning, inference, communication, and language use in context. Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors.
